description: Steps of the vector set reply comparison that fail on the labelled server; labels-off has none.

categories.reason: DUMP and RESTORE are refused while a scheme is configured, so the set dmp2 the case restores never exists and the steps that read it, list it or sort it differ too.
entries: semantics case RESP2 #1398 RESTORE dmp2 0 <stored dump>
semantics case RESP2 #1400 VEMB dmp2 a
semantics case RESP2 #1411 SORT dmp2 ALPHA
semantics case RESP2 #1413 SCAN 0 TYPE vectorset COUNT 1000
